name: ES vs CL Correlation: Pre-RTH vs Open Hour
description: Compares the 60-bar rolling correlation between ES and CL returns across two intraday windows: pre-RTH (08:00–09:30 ET) and the opening RTH hour (09:30–11:30 ET). Uses 5-minute bars and close-to-close returns. Answers: is the ES/CL relationship noisier during the open hour than pre-market?
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES vs CL Correlation: Pre-RTH vs Open Hour
# =============================================================================
# Compares 60-bar rolling correlation of ES/CL returns across two windows:
#   - Pre-RTH:  08:00–09:30 ET (90 min = 18 bars at 5Min)
#   - Open RTH: 09:30–11:30 ET (120 min = 24 bars at 5Min)
#
# Rolling window: 60 bars (5 days of intraday bars per session)
# Correlation input: close-to-close returns (removes trend, measures co-movement)
#
# Key question: Is the ES/CL relationship noisier during the open hour?
# Noisier = wider distribution, lower median, higher std dev of rolling corr.
#
# Asset: ES-Futures (primary)
# CL: loaded via reference_futures + futures_continuation
# Resolution: 5-minute bars
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCES ===
src = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
es_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

cl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='CL')()
cl_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(cl_raw.o, cl_raw.h, cl_raw.l, cl_raw.c, cl_raw.v, cl_raw.oi, cl_raw.s)

# === CLOSE-TO-CLOSE RETURNS (bar-by-bar on 5Min stream) ===
# Use close-to-close returns to remove price-level trend and measure co-movement
es_ret = returns(period=1)(es_cont.c)
cl_ret = returns(period=1)(cl_cont.c)

# === SESSION WINDOWS ===
# Pre-RTH: 08:00–09:30 ET (Globex/CME pre-open, 18 bars at 5Min)
pre_rth_sw = session_window(
    session=Session(start='08:00', end='09:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# Open RTH: 09:30–11:30 ET (first 2 hours of regular session, 24 bars at 5Min)
open_rth_sw = session_window(
    session=Session(start='09:30', end='11:30', tz='America/New_York')
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)

# === 60-BAR ROLLING CORRELATION (computed on full 5Min stream) ===
# The rolling_corr runs on all bars; we then mask to each session's active bars
# and snapshot at session close to get one value per session-day.
corr_60 = rolling_corr(window=60)(es_ret, cl_ret)

# === MASK CORRELATION TO EACH SESSION ===
# Only keep correlation values when the respective session is active
# This gives us the intra-session rolling correlation trajectory
pre_rth_corr_active = where(pre_rth_sw.active, corr_60)
open_rth_corr_active = where(open_rth_sw.active, corr_60)

# === EOD SNAPSHOTS: capture final correlation value at each session close ===
# At session close, the rolling corr reflects the last 60 bars ending within that session
pre_rth_corr_eod = where(pre_rth_sw.closed, corr_60)
open_rth_corr_eod = where(open_rth_sw.closed, corr_60)

# Forward-fill to carry each session's final value forward for distribution analysis
pre_rth_corr_daily = ffill(pre_rth_corr_eod)
open_rth_corr_daily = ffill(open_rth_corr_eod)

# Bar index timestamp for time series x-axis
bar_ts = index()

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Distribution Stats Summary Table (FIRST — reference numbers) ---
# Rows: Median, Std Dev, Min, Max for each window
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ES/CL Correlation Distribution: Pre-RTH vs Open RTH',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Median', 'Std Dev', 'Min', 'Max'],
        col_headers=['Pre-RTH (08:00–09:30)', 'Open RTH (09:30–11:30)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='ES vs CL Correlation by Session',
    order=0
)(pre_rth_corr_daily, open_rth_corr_daily, pre_rth_corr_daily, open_rth_corr_daily, pre_rth_corr_daily, open_rth_corr_daily, pre_rth_corr_daily, open_rth_corr_daily)

# --- 2. Rolling Correlation Time Series (both windows overlaid) ---
# Shows WHEN the two windows diverge — e.g., open hour noisier during macro events
xy_lines(
    title='Does the Open Hour Decouple ES from CL?',
    category='ES vs CL Correlation by Session',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Pre-RTH (08:00–09:30)', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Open RTH (09:30–11:30)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='+0.5', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, title='-0.5', color=Color.Blue, dash_style=DashStyle.ShortDash)
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Rolling 60-Bar Correlation',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    order=1
)(x_values=bar_ts, y_values=(pre_rth_corr_daily, open_rth_corr_daily))

# --- 3. Boxplot: Distribution Comparison (pre-RTH vs Open RTH side-by-side) ---
# Variadic mode: each input column becomes one box
# Higher IQR / wider whiskers = noisier correlation in that window
boxplot(
    title='Is the Open Hour Noisier? ES/CL Correlation Spread',
    category='ES vs CL Correlation by Session',
    series_names=['Pre-RTH (08:00–09:30)', 'Open RTH (09:30–11:30)'],
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Gray],
    show_outliers=True,
    show_data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Rolling 60-Bar Correlation',
    y_axis_dp=2,
    order=2
)(pre_rth_corr_daily, open_rth_corr_daily)
